title: ArchitectureConstraint
description: TOGAF-sourced directive archetype — a limitation on the degrees of freedom in architecture design. In TOGAF, Constraints span Directives (intent: what constrains design) and Norms (measurable: how to verify constraint compliance). This schema captures the directive facet. See also ConstraintCompliance in norms/ for the measurable facet. Requires GSM unsealing of Directive to be functional. Extends Directive with TOGAF Architecture Constraints vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Constraint (ADM Requirements Management, Architecture Constraints). Source framework: TOGAF (ADM, Requirements Management).

constraintSource.description: Origin of the constraint. TOGAF mapping: Constraint source classification (ADM Requirements Management).

scope.description: Constraint applicability scope. TOGAF mapping: Constraint governance scope.

flexibility.description: Degree to which this constraint can be relaxed. ABSOLUTE = immovable. NEGOTIABLE = can be waived with approval. TOGAF mapping: Constraint flexibility assessment.
